verdict.rationale: Lindy's Guardrails setting decides which actions it may take "without asking", which implies it stops and asks a human before other actions. Email drafting is explicitly approval-gated ("Nothing goes out without your approval"). There is no documentation of a workflow or routine step that pauses execution, waits for approval or input, and then resumes. missing for 10: an explicit pause/approval step in routines or workflows, documented collection of human input mid-run, resume or timeout behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues

citations.quote: Guardrails decide what Lindy can do without asking. This is the setting that matters most for Teammate.
Every draft lands in your drafts folder for you to review, edit, and send. Nothing goes out without your approval.
